I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I confirmed the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 10 June, and that I'll use it instead of the date from her #north-team post this morning. She said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else.

I didn't repeat this morning's date in #north-random, since that channel's members may not be able to see #north-team. The 10 June date is fine to share there: Ilse posted it in that channel herself, and a renewal date isn't a finance figure.
